mission: Prepare a content-verified Git LFS candidate for the phone's unpublished Heady binary commits without editing phone main, changing any accepted asset, publishing automatically, force-pushing, or rewriting GitHub history.

requiredRules: live Campaign Etiquette in Google Drive

externalExecution.credentialHandling: Use existing origin auth. Never print tokens or introduce alternate remote.
externalExecution.success: Candidate is fast-forward from latest origin/main; all original Heady binary SHA256 match candidate working files; all candidate paths are LFS pointers; original HEAD/worktree unchanged; local JSON receipt.
exclusions: No force push, remote push, GitHub main change, PR creation or automatic merge
No deleting, conflating or symlinking unequal-source GLBs
No Computer Hands, alternate device or Home Center
No full historical cleanup of previously published oversized Git objects

release.status: source published on dedicated campaign branch; phone invocation unverified
expectedOutputs: audit of sizes and exact duplicate SHA groups
LFS pointer and content SHA validation
release.publishRequires: Separately authorized remote operation from candidate clone; no force push.
